BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORD

Frank J. Wilstach, comp.  A Dictionary of Similes.  1916.

Matthew Arnold

Checks, like men who live, and draw the vital air.
Clustering like bee-hives on the low flat strand of Oxus.
Cold as the grave.
Consumed her … like a flame.
Crawl like shadows forth in Spring.
Drops like a plummet.
Fade like grass.
Heavy as death.
Intrude like comets on the heavenly solitude.
His look was like a sad embrace.
Melts like a passing smoke, a nightly dream.
Rolling like a sea.
Soil’d, like the soil’d tissue of white violets left, freshly gather’d, on their native bank, by children whom their nurses call with haste indoors from the sun’s eye.
Stirr’d, like a clarion-blast.
Sweeps … along, like the broad volume of the insurgent Nile.
